summary: Implemented data flywheel. (1) bench-heldout.js: added step e3 — after token extraction, copies transcript to bench/heldout/journals/{sessionId}.jsonl; adds journalPath field to result row. (2) New scripts/bench-mine-journals.js: reads results-heldout.jsonl, filters by arm (skip off by default) and solved (skip failed by default), runs extract-decisions.js --no-dedup --out <tmpfile> on each journal, merges all candidates, writes bench/heldout/journals/CANDIDATES.json. Flags: --results, --all, --include-failed, --confirm. With --confirm, reruns extract-decisions --confirm per journal to inject into KB.

subject: Implement data flywheel: bench runner journal capture + bulk KB miner
description:
1. In bench-heldout.js: copy the Claude transcript JSONL into bench/heldout/journals/<sessionId>.jsonl right after it's located in step (e), so journals are co-located with results and survive ~/.claude cache rotation.
2. New script scripts/bench-mine-journals.js: reads results-heldout.jsonl, runs extract-decisions.js on each journal path (filtered by arm=on or --all), deduplicates across runs, optionally --confirm injects. Prints a summary of candidates found/injected.
3. Update bench/heldout/results-heldout.jsonl schema comment to include journalPath field.
